Use the <nyx-player> tag without a build step.

The custom element entry provides zero-build integration for any page (HTML / Hexo / static blogs / doc sites): the `<nyx-player>` tag auto-registers, and configuration is passed via the `config` attribute (JSON string) or the `.config` property.

## Loading assets

```html
<script type="module" src="https://unpkg.com/nyx-player-solid/custom-element"></script>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/nyx-player-solid/style" />
```

Local build artifacts:

```html
<script type="module" src="./node_modules/nyx-player-solid/custom-element.js"></script>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="./node_modules/nyx-player-solid/nyx-player.css" />
```

## Basic usage

```html
<nyx-player
  config='{
    "urls": [
      {
        "name": "demo",
        "songs": [
          { "name": "Track", "artist": "Artist", "url": "/audio/song.mp3", "pic": "/cover.jpg", "lrc": "[00:00.00]lyrics" }
        ]
      }
    ],
    "showBtn": "#show",
    "playBtn": "#play",
    "preset": "shokax",
    "darkModeTarget": "html[data-theme='dark']"
  }'
></nyx-player>
```

The top-level `config` JSON supports `urls` / `showBtn` / `playBtn` / `darkModeTarget` / `preset` / `persist`.

## Attributes

| Attribute | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `config` | JSON-serialized full config (highest priority) |
| `urls` | JSON-serialized `PlaylistSource[]` (alternative to `config`) |
| `showBtn` / `playBtn` | External button selectors |
| `darkModeTarget` / `preset` | Theming |

Complex values (`styles`, `provider`) cannot be expressed as JSON attributes — assign via the property:

```js
const el = document.querySelector("nyx-player");
el.config = {
  urls: [...],
  styles: { styles: { light: { primary: "rgb(233, 84, 107)" } } },
};
```

## Manual registration

The module auto-registers `<nyx-player>`; for custom tag names or multi-instance registration:

```ts
import { registerNyxPlayerElement } from "nyx-player-solid/custom-element";

registerNyxPlayerElement();
```

## SSR / no Web Components

When `customElements` is unavailable (SSR, old browsers), registration is silently skipped — no errors.

MediaSession, drag-to-seek, lyrics enhancements, MiniBar, history and visualization.

All R4 extensions are built in and enabled by default (unless stated otherwise).

## MediaSession + global media keys

The player connects to the system media center: play / pause / previous / next / seek media keys and lock-screen controls work; `navigator.mediaSession.metadata` (title / artist / cover) updates with the current track.

`<NyxPlayer>` mounts it by default; for programmatic use:

```tsx
import { useMediaSession } from "nyx-player-solid";

// call after instantiating the store (session injectable for tests; null disables)
useMediaSession(store);
```

## Drag-to-seek and volume slider

- The progress bar supports pointer dragging: the position previews live while dragging, **seek commits on release**; `←`/`→` nudge ±5s
- A volume slider (`input[type=range]`) replaces the plain mute button; muted shows 0 and unmuting restores the previous value

## Lyrics enhancements

- **Karaoke word-level highlighting** for LLRC timestamps `<mm:ss.xx>word`; plain LRC degrades to whole-line highlight automatically
- **Click-to-seek**: clicking any lyric line jumps to its start time
- Parsers live in the core: `parseWordLyric` / `activeWordIndex` (see [Reference](/en/reference/core-api/))

## MiniBar mode

```tsx
<NyxPlayer urls={urls} mode="mini" />
```

A bar with cover + title + play/pause + expand button; expanding returns to the full panel.

## Cross-playlist playback + history

- When a playlist ends, playback moves to the **next non-empty playlist** (circular; `mode="loop"` stays single-track, never crosses)
- Play history: `back()` / `forward()` / `clearHistory()` / `getHistory()` (browser-style navigation; new navigation drops the forward branch)

```tsx
<button onClick={() => player.back()}>Back</button>
<button onClick={() => player.forward()}>Forward</button>
```

## Audio visualization

`AudioAdapter.getContextAnalysis()` exposes the WebAudio `AnalyserNode` (lazy-created, connected back to destination). Frame rate adapts to the **CPU performance tier**:

- WICG CPU Performance API (`navigator.cpuPerformance`, 1-4) **tier ≥ 4 → 60fps**
- Otherwise / API not shipped (common in production today) → 30fps low frame rate

```tsx
import { cpuPerformanceLevel, visualizerFrameIntervalMs } from "nyx-player-solid";

const level = cpuPerformanceLevel(); // number | null
const interval = visualizerFrameIntervalMs(level); // 16 | 33
```

Works automatically wherever `AudioContext` exists; the rAF loop stops when the panel closes/collapses.

## Usage in a Solid project

```tsx
import { NyxPlayer } from "nyx-player-solid";
import "nyx-player-solid/style";

const songs = [
  {
    name: "Demo track 1",
    artist: "demo",
    url: "https://example.com/song1.mp3",
    pic: "https://example.com/cover1.jpg",
    lrc: "[00:00.00]First line\n[00:10.00]Second line",
  },
];

export function Player() {
  return (
    <NyxPlayer
      urls={[{ name: "demo", songs }]}
      showBtn="#show" // toggle button on your page (selector)
      playBtn="#play" // play/pause button on your page
      preset="shokax"
    />
  );
}
```

Provide the two external buttons on your page:

```html
<button id="show">Show / Hide player</button>
<button id="play">Play / Pause</button>
```

> External buttons also accept an `HTMLElement` or an element-returning function — see [Component API](/en/guides/component-api/).

## MediaSession + 全局媒体键

播放器接入系统媒体中心：播放/暂停/上一首/下一首/跳转媒体键与锁屏控制可用；`navigator.mediaSession.metadata`（标题 / 歌手 / 封面）随当前歌曲更新。

`<NyxPlayer>` 默认挂载；编程式场景用 `useMediaSession`：

```tsx
import { useMediaSession } from "nyx-player-solid";

// 在 store 实例化后调用（session 可注入以便测试；null 强制禁用）
useMediaSession(store);
```

## 拖拽 Seek 与音量滑杆

- 进度条支持指针拖拽：拖拽中实时预览位置，**松手才 seek**；键盘 `←`/`→` 微调 ±5s
- 音量滑杆（`input[type=range]`）替代纯静音按钮；静音时滑杆显示 0，取消静音恢复原值

## 歌词增强

- **卡拉 OK 逐字**：支持 LLRC 词级时间戳 `<mm:ss.xx>词`，当前行逐词点亮；无词级标签的普通 LRC 自动退化为整词高亮
- **行点击 seek**：点击任意歌词行跳到该行开始时间
- 解析器在 core 层：`parseWordLyric` / `activeWordIndex`（见[参考](/reference/core-api/)）

## MiniBar 双形态

```tsx
<NyxPlayer urls={urls} mode="mini" />
```

浮条形态：封面 + 标题 + 播放/暂停 + 展开按钮；点击展开回到完整面板。

## 跨歌单连续播放 + 播放历史

- 歌单播完自动跳到**下一非空歌单**（环形回绕；`mode="loop"` 时单曲循环优先，不跨歌单）
- 播放历史：`back()` / `forward()` / `clearHistory()` / `getHistory()`（浏览器式后退/前进；主动切歌丢弃前进分支）

```tsx
<button onClick={() => player.back()}>后退</button>
<button onClick={() => player.forward()}>前进</button>
```

## 音频可视化

`AudioAdapter.getContextAnalysis()` 提供 WebAudio `AnalyserNode`（懒创建、连回 destination）。可视化按 **CPU 性能层级自适应帧率**：

- WICG CPU Performance API（`navigator.cpuPerformance`，1-4）**层级 ≥4 → 60fps**
- 否则 / API 未发布（当前生产环境常见）→ 30fps 低帧率

```tsx
import { cpuPerformanceLevel, visualizerFrameIntervalMs } from "nyx-player-solid";

const level = cpuPerformanceLevel(); // number | null
const interval = visualizerFrameIntervalMs(level); // 16 | 33
```

只要环境支持 `AudioContext` 即自动工作；面板关闭/折叠时 rAF 自动停止。
